task: Remove the typed-hard-limit cascade in the Create/Update Budget modal so Platform/CLI/Premium edits change only their own field, show an under/over distribution warning instead, keep drag-and-drop redistribution, and preserve the EPMCDME-16015 Platform minimum.

key_reasoning.reason: Six concrete ACs, but open points remain: AC5 (no auto-correction) conflicts with AC6 (16015 Platform minimum is itself a correction), whether the per-category upper clamp (100 - peer) is removed or capped at 100%, whether the typed category's own soft-limit rescale counts as auto-correction, and how drag behaves from an unbalanced state. These are 1-2 light decisions, not architectural ones.

Closest pattern is the existing sumPctError inline message plus submitDisabled gating in UnifiedProjectBudgetModal, and the backend already rejects non-100 sums, so the change is mostly removing onHardInputChange cascade logic (baseline S). Bumped to M: ACs enumerate edge/variant cases (set-to-0, under vs over) and no existing test covers the cascade absence, sum-warning messaging, submit gating or soft-rescale on typed edits; four platformMin tests implicitly depend on the cascade and must be rewritten. Calibrated against bundled S example epmcdme-10102-add-validation-to-form-field (total 11), which agrees.

UnifiedProjectBudgetModal.tsx plus possibly BudgetCategoryTable.tsx for under/over messaging, the platformMin test file to rewrite, and likely one new test file - all within the administration/components directory and its __tests__.
